info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Cheque Lock Box Retrieval API
info.description: The Cheque Lock Box Retrieval API allows users to access and manage cheque lock box details effectively. This API facilitates the retrieval of specific cheque lock box information using a unique identifier. It is typically utilized by financial institutions, bankers, and accounting professionals to streamline cheque processing and management activities. Users can leverage this API to enhance operational efficiencies and improve customer service by ensuring timely access to crucial banking data.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the details of a specific Cheque Lock Box using its unique identifier. Ensure you have the necessary permissions to access this information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information related to cheque lockbox operations. It allows the client to specify the required parameters in JSON format to receive the relevant response.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the details of the cheque lock box.

GetChequeLockBoxByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on the cheque lock box in trade banking.

GetChequeLockBoxByIdResponse_200.title: Cheque Lock Box Response

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the record was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.
